posts.text: Mercuria har gått til voldgiftssak mot Baltic Exchange i april 2026 så saken mot Hunter Group er bare en liten del av saken Commodity trader Mercuria Energy Group filed a lawsuit in London’s High Court against the Baltic Exchange in April 2026 over alleged distortions in the key TD3C oil shipping benchmark. https://www.bairdmaritime.com/shipping/baltic-exchange-blames-mercuria-lawsuit-for-muddying-shipping-markets https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-04-30/mercuria-sues-baltic-exchange-over-hormuz-hit-shipping-benchmark
